title: Queue item
description: A research hit handed to audio production: a narrated story from a written source, or a clip from a podcast episode.

kind.description: story: narrated from a written source. clip: cut from a podcast episode.

source_link.description: Article URL, or for a clip the episode link including its timestamp.

why_it_matters.description: Why this item matters for the lens.

headline.description: Story only. One-line headline in plain words.

verified_facts.description: Story only. The facts the narration may use, each one checked against the source. Narration adds nothing beyond these.

verbatim_quote.description: Clip only. The quote copied word for word from the saved transcript.

start_time.description: Clip only. Approximate start (for example HH:MM:SS).

end_time.description: Clip only. Approximate end (for example HH:MM:SS). The span should be 60–150 seconds.

episode_audio_url.description: Clip only. Episode audio URL from the RSS enclosure.

claim_type.description: Do not upgrade one type to another in the summary or the script.

dedupe_key.description: Optional. Set by the contributor; the intake API derives one if absent (see ARCHITECTURE C2).

found_at.description: Optional. When research found the item (ISO 8601).

topics.description: Optional. Lens topics this item hits, by name from lens.md.
